_method: Labelled by reading the source at the pinned commit. `true` = must be reported at medium severity or above; `false` = must not be. Each entry names the specific call that justifies it.

true.why: execute_with_pty() reaches os.execvp('/bin/sh', ...) with a model-controlled command. The canonical PTY shell tool.
exec(code, namespace) on a model-supplied `code` string. The canonical REPL tool.
_read_crontab() calls subprocess.run(['crontab', ...]); the tool schedules arbitrary commands.
focus_application() calls subprocess.run(['osascript', ...]) with model-influenced input.

false.why: subprocess.run(['say', text]): a fixed program with model-controlled arguments. The model chooses what is said, not what runs. Reported at low severity, which is correct; reporting it as a shell would be a false positive.
time_machine_view() runs subprocess.check_output(['git', ...]) with a path argument. Same shape as speak: fixed program, model-controlled arguments, low severity.
